# DiskScope 0.1.1
- Clearer sunburst maps for large scans: related folder colours, grouped small items, readable overview rings and deeper detail when exploring folders. - Compact Settings windows sized for each tab. - Forget saved locations from Privacy & Access or the sidebar without deleting their files. - Remove individual cached scans or clear the scan cache in Settings. Open scan results remain available.
Updates retain the same code-signing identity and update verification key as 0.1.0.
This free release is self-signed and unnotarized. macOS controls first-launch approval and protected-folder access.
[Installation guide](https://mes30004e.github.io/DiskScope/#installation) · [Permissions guide](https://mes30004e.github.io/DiskScope/permissions.html)
